items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Yeah, Walter Deku was playing right in the same neighborhood with us. Yes, I know him.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. What was your name? Do you remember him? I think he left pretty early. Yeah.

Well, I never did, you know, learn the name to know him. Just like now. These, some of these older musicians, I don't know. You made me know my nickname. I don't know how it is. Yeah. Yeah. All right. And let me see who else used to play piano. Oh, yeah. That boy that killed the fellow, but his name again. Oh, yeah. He killed one of his. Oh, I know. Walter Deku. Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
